import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/stage_release.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1, 2)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    before=tree('release source');manifest_before=get('deploy/release.tsv')
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(manifest_before),delimiter='\t'))
    expected={r['target']:before[r['source']] for r in rows}
    put('live release/stale.txt','old release\n');put('live release/nested/keep-before-failure.txt','old\n')
    old=tree('live release')
    if not BASE:
        r=run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release','--plan')
        assert r.stdout == ''.join(x['target']+'\t'+x['sha256']+'\n' for x in sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r['target']))
        assert tree('live release') == old
        run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','not published','--plan')
        assert not (root/'not published').exists()
    # Damage a late source: earlier files must never overwrite an old release.
    last=rows[-1]['source'];put('release source/'+last,'corrupt\n')
    run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release',code=2)
    assert tree('live release') == old
    run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','not published',code=2)
    assert not (root/'not published').exists()
    if not BASE:
        run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release','--plan',code=2)
        assert tree('live release') == old
    put('release source/'+last,before[last])
    first=rows[0]['source'];(root/'release source'/first).unlink()
    run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release',code=2);assert tree('live release') == old
    put('release source/'+first,before[first])
    run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release');assert tree('live release') == expected
    run('release source','deploy/release.tsv','live release');assert tree('live release') == expected
    assert tree('release source') == before and get('deploy/release.tsv') == manifest_before
    put('empty release.tsv','source\ttarget\tsha256\n')
    run('release source','empty release.tsv','live release');assert tree('live release') == {}
    # A different source/target mapping checks that the manifest drives the copy.
    put('alternate source/value.txt','region=blue\n')
    digest=hashlib.sha256(b'region=blue\n').hexdigest()
    put('alternate manifest.tsv','source\ttarget\tsha256\nvalue.txt\tdeep/config.txt\t'+digest+'\n')
    run('alternate source','alternate manifest.tsv','new parent/new release')
    assert tree('new parent/new release') == {'deep/config.txt':'region=blue\n'}
    if not BASE:
        old_new=tree('new parent/new release')
        run('release source','empty release.tsv','new parent/new release','--plan')
        assert tree('new parent/new release') == old_new
        assert run('release source','empty release.tsv','new parent/new release','--plan').stdout == ''
        run('release source','empty release.tsv','empty planned','--plan')
        assert not (root/'empty planned').exists()
        (root/'alternate source/value.txt').unlink()
        run('alternate source','alternate manifest.tsv','new parent/new release','--plan',code=2)
        assert tree('new parent/new release') == old_new
        run('alternate source','alternate manifest.tsv','never planned','--plan',code=2)
        assert not (root/'never planned').exists()
    run('release source','empty release.tsv','new empty parent/release')
    assert (root/'new empty parent/release').is_dir() and tree('new empty parent/release') == {}
    assert (root/'live release').is_dir()

发布配置时必须先验证完整性，不能一边复制一边发现错误。新写 `bash scripts/stage_release.sh SOURCE MANIFEST DEST`。MANIFEST 是 source/target/sha256 三列 TSV；source 为 SOURCE 内普通文本文件的相对路径，target 为发布目录内的目标相对路径，sha256 是源文件字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制。target 只含 ASCII 字符；所有路径合法且不越界；target 唯一，彼此没有文件/父目录冲突。任一源文件缺失或摘要不符时退出 2，DEST 若已存在，目录内所有文本内容必须原样；原来不存在则不创建 DEST。全部验证成功后退出 0，把 DEST 完整替换为清单指定的目标文件树（清除旧文件），内容和源文件相同；成功时创建父目录。空清单生成空目录。SOURCE、MANIFEST、DEST 互不重叠，不需处理系统崩溃或并发修改。release source/ 和 deploy/release.tsv 是当前发布材料。
工作目录 /app。请新写 `scripts/stage_release.sh`，并实际运行 `python3 tests/check_stage_release.py base` 验证。检查脚本在受保护的 tests/ 下，不要修改；原始输入文件保持不变。脚本须支持任意传入路径（含空格），不要硬编码示例结果。容器有 bash、coreutils、python3 标准库；无网络、git、jq、curl 或 gawk。可以在 shell 中调用 python3，写法须同时适用于 macOS 和 Debian。

增加第四参数 `--plan`。计划模式仍要验证全部源文件和摘要，失败行为和退出码与上一轮相同；成功时不创建或修改 DEST，只向标准输出打印 `target<TAB>sha256`，无表头，按 target 的 ASCII 顺序。不带此参数时仍执行发布。计划必须与实际发布的文件集合一致，不能把旧 DEST 文件列入计划。
在上一轮脚本上继续；运行 `python3 tests/check_stage_release.py` 验证。tests/ 仍不可修改。
